query.value:
INSERT INTO coupon_usage (
    order_number, 
    transaction_number, 
    coupon_code, 
    applied_on, 
    status, 
    created_at, 
    order_value, 
    discount_value, 
    rules
) VALUES (
    '{{.Extracting_the_required_inputs.output.orderId}}', 
    '{{.Extracting_the_required_inputs.output.txn_no}}', 
    '{{.Extracting_the_required_inputs.output.coupon_code}}', 
    NOW(), 
    'applied', 
    NOW(), 
    {{.Validate_Coupon_SubWorkflow.output.cart_value}},
    {{.Validate_Coupon_SubWorkflow.output.cart_value}} - {{.Validate_Coupon_SubWorkflow.output.discounted_price}},  
    'Discount provided after validation'
) ON CONFLICT (order_number)
DO UPDATE SET
    status = 'applied',
    applied_on = NOW();
